C6.finding: `apr pull` is not sha-stable by itself. Its cache hit compares file size only, yet prints 'cached, verified' (pull.rs, the cache-hit branch in download_shard), and a re-download rewrites .apr-manifest.json with the new hashes. A re-pushed revision with the same size is accepted silently. The gate catches it on a release dir; pull does not
